newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan banks cut loan rates by one percent.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan banks cut loan rates by one percent.

text.p: Morocco's commercial banks on Tuesday reduced interest rates by one percentage point on medium and long term investment loans, a Casablanca-based banker said.

"Banks have reduced on Tuesday interest rate on medium and long term loans by 1.0 percent to encourage investors...The move also aims at upgrading local firms," an official at Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur told Reuters.
Prime rates for medium- and long-term investment loans now stand at 10.50 and 11.25 percent.
"The discount is a part of a promotional campaign which ends on December 31, 1997," he said.
The move follows guidelines issued by the monetary authorities in January which advised banks to reduce rates to attract more investment.
